propositions: Plan-review Pass-2 rejects all verification indices as unexpected when Pass-1 yields zero findings, causing a contract violation

The verify_instructions() kernel returns 'Emit one verification per finding' for empty batches, creating a truthfulness mismatch that causes the model to emit indices 0..N-1 against an empty index domain
INDETERMINATE findings from Pass-2 degradation cannot cause BLOCK decisions and are silently absorbed if any advisory surfaces
Empty batch synthesis via verify_instructions(chunks or [[]]) occurs whenever findings=[], producing one empty chunk and one verify request despite no findings to verify
The fix replaces the empty-batch instruction with EMPTY_BATCH_INSTRUCTIONS='No findings to verify; return an empty verifications array' to align request contract with response expectations
